description: This source file is part of the Git codebase, specifically related to revision listing, commit graph traversal, and object graph analysis. It includes functions for marking objects uninteresting, handling revisions, processing commits and trees, and managing revision traversal parameters.

classes.name: struct path_and_oids_entry

classes.name: struct treesame_state
classes.description: Represents the state of treesame flags for a commit, including the number of parents and a boolean array indicating treesame status for each parent.
